name: Aisha Hassan
psychographics: Prioritises stability and keeping cultural traditions alive while navigating unfamiliar systems
current_solutions: Uses Revolut for remittances to Nairobi; shops at local Halal butcher and Aldi for groceries; pays bills in cash at the post office
frustration: Tried to set up a standing order with her UK bank at 2pm on Tuesday; the branch was closed for 'lunch break' and the app timed out after 12 minutes, forcing her to take a bus to the branch before it closed at 5pm
decision_style: Compares prices across three different apps before buying; often buys the cheapest option and regrets it later
voice: Short, direct sentences with a habit of switching to Arabic phrases when frustrated; speaks in a northern English accent interspersed with Swahili greetings
